## Introduction


The December promotion ideas that rank online tend to be a calendar of dates and a stack of email templates. Useful, but they skip the hard question.


What do you offer after Black Friday, once the sitewide sale is over and your margin has already paid for a week of markdowns?


This guide picks up where our[Black Friday 2026 full-price plays](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/black-friday-2026-without-discounting-10-full-price-plays-and-the-numbers-behind-them) stop. It gives you eight December offers that hold the price on the tag, from the shipping cutoff rush to the last week of the year.


Several of them run on the conditional rebate that[Playably](https://playably.ai/) builds for Shopify brands. Shoppers buy at full price, and if a real, published trigger event hits, Playably pays them 100% of their order back.


It's our blog, so our mechanic shows up. The rest work on their own.


### Key Takeaways


- December promotion ideas can hold full price after the Black Friday sale ends.
- Playably's conditional rebate pays shoppers 100% back if a real trigger hits.
- The brand pays $0 of the rebate because Playably insures and hedges the payout.
- Buckle Me Baby Coats saw sales jump 23% on launch with price untouched.
- Gift bundles, cart nudges and thank-you plays all work without a markdown.


## What Black Friday Leaves Behind in December


Black Friday pulls demand forward. By the first week of December, a lot of your most eager shoppers have already bought, and some of them bought at a discount.


That leaves two groups. Shoppers who skipped the sale, and shoppers who bought and might come back for gifts.


Neither group needs a fourth markdown to act. Both respond to a reason to buy now.


If you're still mapping the season, our[Q4 marketing calendar](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/q4-marketing-calendar) lays out the dates. The eight offers below fill them.


## 1. Run a Christmas Snow Rebate


Weather is one of the simplest triggers to explain. Playably has published moments across sports, weather and culture, including a Christmas Day snowfall in New York City.


The published condition reads: "If ≥1″ of snow falls in New York City on December 25, every campaign order pays back 100%." Shoppers buy gifts at full price and watch the forecast with you.


You can browse the[library of pre-modelled moments](https://playably.ai/pages/upcoming-offers) , which Playably refreshes weekly.


Want a different city or a different moment? Bring Playably a trigger it hasn't covered and the team will model the odds and the cap.


Our guide to[weather-triggered promotions](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/weather-triggered-promotions-for-shopify-brands-2026-how-free-if-it-snows-works-and-who-pays) explains how "free if it snows" works and who pays.


## 2. Make It a Christmas Game


December is a natural month for play. A holiday game turns browsing into a reason to come back.


Buckle Me Baby Coats ran one with Playably.


"It was the perfect Christmas game, and I look forward to running it again next year. Sales jumped 23% on launch, participant AOV rose 40%, and we never touched our price," says Dahlia Rizk, CEO & Founder of Buckle Me Baby Coats.


The phrase worth noticing is the last one. The price never moved.


Our post on[what seasonal gamification is](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/what-is-seasonal-gamification) explains the idea behind a holiday game.


## 3. Tie a Rebate to the Games Your Shoppers Watch


December is full of big games. Your shoppers already have the dates in their calendars.


A sports trigger works the same way as weather. Shoppers buy at full price, get auto-entered with no code to remember, and a real result decides whether Playably pays them back.


You get the brand halo of the moment everyone's watching without paying to sponsor it. Our guide to[sports moment marketing](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/sports-moment-marketing) shows how to pick a moment that fits your brand.


The best triggers are events your shoppers are already talking about. That is what makes a campaign spread on its own.


## 4. Win Back Black Friday Buyers Without Another Code


Your November buyers are your warmest December audience. Invite them back with a full-price offer instead of a deeper discount.


A conditional rebate gives them a reason to buy a gift for someone else. It also keeps December from becoming a race to the bottom with your own November prices.


Codes still have a place. The choice is whether December runs on another markdown or on a moment.


Our playbook on how to[win back shoppers without discounts](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/win-back-customers-without-discounts) goes further on bringing past buyers back.


## 5. Sell Full-Price Gift Bundles Before the Shipping Cutoff


The shipping cutoff is December's natural deadline. Use it instead of a fake countdown on a discount.


Bundle a bestseller with a smaller add-on, price the set at the full combined price, and ship it gift ready. The deadline does the urgency work.


Bundles lift the order total without cutting the price of either product. Our guide on how to[increase average order value](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/increase-average-order-value) has more ideas for lifting basket size.


## 6. Recover December Carts With a Rebate Nudge


Cart abandonment doesn't stop for the holidays. The usual fix is a coupon in the second or third reminder email.


There is another option. Point that reminder at a live rebate, so the shopper finishes checkout at full price with a chance to win the order back.


Our guide to[abandoned cart recovery without discounts](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/abandoned-cart-recovery-without-discounts) goes deeper on full-price recovery.


## 7. Take the Same Offer to Pop-Ups, Shelves and Events


December selling happens off your site too. Holiday markets, retail shelves and live events all carry gift traffic.


The same Play & Win loop runs on site, in playable ads, in store by QR and at live events. A QR on the packaging or a POS sign turns any shelf into an entry point.


At an event, it's a code on the jumbotron, a text after kickoff, a card at the gate. One mechanic, every place your shoppers are.


Our explainer on[how gamified rebates work](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/gamified-rebates-the-full-price-promotion-that-pays-shoppers-back-when-a-real-world-event-hits) covers the loop from entry to payout.


## 8. Close the Year With a Thank-You Play


The last week of December is quiet for a lot of stores. Use it to thank everyone who bought this season.


Invite them to play, and keep what they tell you. Every play reveals preferences and intent, and that zero party data feeds segmentation, recommendations and lifecycle flows long after the campaign ends.


You start January knowing who bought gifts, who bought for themselves and what each group wants next. Our guide to[zero party data collection](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/zero-party-data-collection) shows how to use it.


## How to Choose Your December Offers


Pick one offer per stage of the month. A trigger-led rebate for the early December gift rush, bundles for the shipping cutoff, and a thank-you play for the final week.


Full-price offers can hold up even when markdowns are everywhere.


During Jordan Craig's NFL Draft rebate, 93% of buyers walked past two 25%-off sitewide sales running the same month, and baskets ran 34% bigger than the store average at full price. The[Jordan Craig case study](https://playably.ai/pages/jordancraig-case-study) has the detail.


The work on your side stays small. Playably wires the campaign, the widget and the payout, with no dev work and no discounting on your end, and your team approves the brief.


Most Playably campaigns go live in days rather than months. December dates don't move, so[book a demo](https://playably.ai/pages/book-a-demo) early enough to pick the moment you want.


## Conclusion


The best December promotion ideas for 2026 give shoppers a reason to buy after Black Friday without cutting the price again. A Christmas snow rebate, a holiday game, a sports trigger, full-price bundles and a thank-you play all do that.


Playably's conditional rebate sits at the centre of most of them. Shoppers pay full price, Playably insures and hedges the payout, and you pay $0 of the rebate while keeping your margin.
